objective_summary: Independently polish and modularize the active Giants football-operations shell, deterministic decision presentation, and evidence inspector without changing public API contracts.

nodes.goal: Inspect the active src/nyg shell and improve only its CSS for sober football-operations hierarchy, legibility, responsive behavior at 1440x900, 1280x720, and 1024x768, keyboard focus visibility, and presenter-safe overflow. Do not change component contracts or copy. Return codex_task_worker_result.v1.
nodes.expected_output: A bounded CSS-only patch with responsive and accessibility improvements, or a no-change result with evidence.
nodes.verification: Run root typecheck/build if dependencies are available; otherwise run static syntax/banned-term checks and report the environment boundary.
nodes.stop_condition: Stop rather than hiding material content, shrinking text below usable presentation size, or adding decorative theatrics.

nodes.goal: Extract a focused Decision Room component from the current active src/nyg/NygApp.tsx into src/nyg/DecisionRoom.tsx. Preserve behavior and public props, strengthen loading/insufficient-evidence/impossible-target rendering, and keep deterministic values immutable. Do not edit NygApp.tsx; root will integrate the exported component. Return codex_task_worker_result.v1.
nodes.expected_output: A reusable DecisionRoom component ready for root integration with explicit blocked, insufficient, and loading states.
nodes.verification: Typecheck the new component against shared NFL types if dependencies are available; otherwise perform a syntax review and document the gap.
nodes.stop_condition: Stop rather than inventing numbers, citations, private inputs, or changing server contracts.

nodes.goal: Extract a focused NFL evidence inspector from the current active src/nyg/NygApp.tsx into src/nyg/EvidencePanel.tsx. It must expose player contract source, captured/derived boundary, exact rule locators, claim usage, football consequence, and next confirmation actions. Do not edit NygApp.tsx; root will integrate it. Return codex_task_worker_result.v1.
nodes.expected_output: A reusable NFL-only evidence component ready for root integration.
nodes.verification: Typecheck if dependencies are available and perform a static scan showing no NBA-only API or type usage.
nodes.stop_condition: Stop when a claim cannot be tied to a player row and exact rule reference; never fabricate missing provenance.
